summary: This standards-track RFC defines a way for a receiver in a multimedia session to pause and later resume an incoming RTP stream from a sender, using real-time feedback messages. This saves bandwidth and resources when a stream is not needed. It updates RFC 5104.

eli5.summary: If you are watching a video call but turn away for a moment, you can tell the other side to stop sending and then start again, so nothing gets wasted.

questions: how to pause an rtp stream
